strings.notes: 宁明 not in 0719; US contact Fisherman Ralph (US 0712)

strings.zh: 现在的年轻人{NEWLINE}都不钓鱼的吗？{SCROLL}我要把钓鱼的乐趣{NEWLINE}统统传授给你,{CLEAR}所以,和我交换号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Don’t young people fish anymore?{SCROLL}I can teach you how to fish well, if{NEWLINE}you’d like to exchange phone{CLEAR}numbers with me? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好！{NEWLINE}能和年轻人交朋友,{CLEAR}我感到好欣慰！
strings.en: That’s great!{NEWLINE}I’m happy to have made a{CLEAR}younger friend!

strings.zh: 是吗⋯⋯{SCROLL}我家的小孩子也告诉我现在{CLEAR}不喜欢和爸爸打电话⋯⋯{SCROLL}难道现在的小孩子都是这样的吗？
strings.en: Oh...{SCROLL}My kids told me they don’t like calling{NEWLINE}their dad anymore, either...{SCROLL}Are all kids like that these days?

strings.zh: 嗯？{NEWLINE}果然你想和我做朋友是吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hm? Oh, so you would like to be my{NEWLINE}friend after all?! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我就在你旁边,{NEWLINE}直接和我面聊吧！
strings.en: If you’re nearby, let’s{NEWLINE}just talk face-to-face!

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:10}最近{NEWLINE}比我的孩子还更经常陪我！{CLEAR}这真是有点悲哀啊。{SCROLL}你有空了也给你的妈妈{NEWLINE}多打打电话吧！
strings.en: I’ve been spending more time with my{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:10} than I have with my kids.{CLEAR}That’s a bit sad, actually.{SCROLL}You call your mom sometimes, too!

strings.zh: 前不久我把{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}打败了！{CLEAR}我还想在孩子面前出出风头,{CLEAR}结果他说这种事他也行,{SCROLL}真是太嚣张了⋯⋯{SCROLL}你有空了也给你的妈妈{NEWLINE}多打打电话吧！
strings.en: I just beat a wild {VAR:0100:11}.{NEWLINE}I told my kid, but he scoffed that he{CLEAR}could do the same thing easily.{SCROLL}Boy, has he gotten cocky...{SCROLL}You call your mom sometimes, too!

strings.zh: 昨天我在孩子的面前{NEWLINE}让{VAR:0100:11}给逃走了,{CLEAR}我当时很失望,{CLEAR}结果他给了我个精灵球！{SCROLL}我感到很欣慰。{SCROLL}你有空了也给你的妈妈{NEWLINE}多打打电话吧！
strings.en: Yesterday, a {VAR:0100:11} got away from{NEWLINE}me in front of my kid. I was really let{CLEAR}down, and then he gave me a Poké Ball!{SCROLL}That really cheered me up.{SCROLL}You should call your mom more often{NEWLINE}when you have time, too!

strings.zh: 你已经好就没和{NEWLINE}我进行精灵对战了,{CLEAR}怎么样？{SCROLL}⋯⋯要来一场吗！{SCROLL}你真是个懂事的孩子！{NEWLINE}那我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: What do you say to a battle with me?{NEWLINE}Good, you’re going to do it!{SCROLL}For a kid, you’re quite agreeable.{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} is the spot!

strings.zh: 喂喂,你现在在哪儿？{NEWLINE}我们要在{VAR:0104:3}对战的！{SCROLL}让年纪大的人等你{NEWLINE}不觉得很羞耻么？
strings.en: So where are you? I’m waiting for you{NEWLINE}to show up on {VAR:0104:3}.{SCROLL}Making your elders wait like this...{NEWLINE}Aren’t you ashamed of yourself?
strings.notes: US 0712/10 | tone review: 不觉得很羞耻么 = 'aren't you ashamed'; US line followed the Chinese (D-0627)

strings.zh: 你最近怎么样？{SCROLL}我当然是巅峰状态了！{SCROLL}哎？你问我的巅峰状态是指{CLEAR}钓鱼的状态还是精灵的状态？{SCROLL}哈哈哈！{NEWLINE}两个都是啦！
strings.en: Hey, how are you doing?{SCROLL}I’m doing absolutely wonderful,{NEWLINE}of course!{SCROLL}But when I say “...absolutely{NEWLINE}wonderful,” am I talking about fishing?{CLEAR}Am I talking about Pokémon?{CLEAR}Which is it?{SCROLL}Ha ha ha!{NEWLINE}It’s both, of course!
